name: LARQ S.a.
summary: Larq S.A. provides custom outdoor advertising services in Poland. The company designs, produces, and implements marketing campaigns, which include out-of-home media, modern urban media systems, and event marketing; and operates advertising space in the underpasses. It is also involved in automating marketing and sales processes through SaaS for residential developers, car dealers, and online store operators. In addition, the company engages in the rental of investment properties and other fixed assets. The company was formerly known as CAM Media S.A. and changed its name to Larq S.A. in October 2015. Larq S.A. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
